MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Samsung memory card with an SD adapter fits my repeated purchases of SD and microSD cards, along with a card reader and storage cases.",
    "The HDMI cable feels useful because I buy practical connection accessories and have a TV and DVD player; its extra length could help connect my setup."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming sticks assume I want a new way to watch TV, but I have no current need for a streaming player, and my 720p TV gives me little reason to seek 4K features.",
    "The Echo speakers and smart plug introduce voice control and home automation that I have not shown an interest in. Buying power strips does not mean I want Alexa-controlled outlets.",
    "The Fire TV Ethernet adapter does not follow from owning a Fire tablet, and a WiFi extender would only interest me if I had a coverage problem."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been treated as interest in other Amazon devices, even when they serve different purposes.",
    "Owning electronics seems to have been taken as a reason to offer new connected devices, while my purchases more often support equipment I already use."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated memory-card purchases, card reader, and storage cases show a continuing interest in storing and moving files across devices.",
    "My tripods, mounts, cables, and recent lens cap suggest that practical fit with existing equipment matters more to me than adding a new device or feature."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The memory card and cable fit my practical accessory needs, but most of the list mistakes device ownership for an immediate interest in streaming and Alexa products."
}
